about: A realm's spec (GitHub #13250): what GET /api/playtest/realms/<slug> answers, text a line each, written in SQL (verse.realm_edit_spec). "lines" names every line: its key, its form, what it says and an example. "steps" are calls to a seeded realm with the status and body the server answers today ("message": Spec is the text; the others are record.proto's, realm.proto's and made.proto's bodies and the API's ErrorReply). aethyr/forge/spec.coax is the one reader; aethyr/forge/spec-goldens.coax reads every line of every spec through it, requires each to be a line named here and to come back the same from its fields; coax/web/api/tests/realm_record_checks.coax makes the calls.

the SHA-256 of the engine manifest pinned with the published revision

realm.seed: INSERT INTO verse.players (id, key_sha256, created_ms) VALUES ('p-spec-fixture', encode(sha256(convert_to('spec-fixture-player-key-0001', 'UTF8')), 'hex'), 1); INSERT INTO verse.worlds (id, owner_player, created_ms) VALUES ('made-spec-fixture', 'p-spec-fixture', 1); INSERT INTO verse.made_realms (slug, world, name, style, ground, time, camera, palette, features, tools, placed, moved, made_ms) VALUES ('spec-fixture', 'made-spec-fixture', 'Spec Fixture', 'painterly', 'sand', 'dusk', 'top', 'pastel', '[{"feature":"water","size":"large","variant":"river"},{"feature":"trees","variant":"pine","count":6},{"feature":"rocks","count":4},{"feature":"house","size":"large","colour":"red","count":3},{"feature":"mist"},{"feature":"character","name":"Old Mott","role":"the ferryman"}]', '{"fly":true,"jump":true,"map":false}', '[{"thing":"barrel","x":0,"z":3.8,"yaw":-1.571},{"thing":"crate","x":-2.25,"z":1,"yaw":0}]', '[{"entity":"trees:1","x":4,"z":-5.5}]', 1);
realm.clean: CREATE TEMP TABLE sf AS SELECT m.slug FROM verse.made_realms m JOIN verse.worlds w ON w.id = m.world WHERE w.owner_player = 'p-spec-fixture'; DELETE FROM verse.realm_publications WHERE slug IN (SELECT slug FROM sf); DELETE FROM verse.realm_revisions WHERE slug IN (SELECT slug FROM sf); DELETE FROM verse.made_realms WHERE slug IN (SELECT slug FROM sf); DELETE FROM verse.worlds WHERE owner_player = 'p-spec-fixture'; DELETE FROM verse.players WHERE id = 'p-spec-fixture';
